question: Hot, dry winds blowing in the Northern plain in India are known as __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Loo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Loo__ is a strong, dusty, gusty, hot, and dry summer wind from the west which blows over the Indo-Gangetic Plain region of North India and Pakistan.
 
• It is especially strong in the months of May and June.
 
• ​Heatstroke is brought about by excessive exposure to the sun heat.
